champion.builds: THE BEST JAYCE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jayce Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick First Strike as your keystone, followed by Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Opportunity. For your last 3 items, you should build Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge and finish with Serpent's Fang. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 50.4% winrate over 2 834 matches played. Optional Your second option for Jayce Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Youmuu's Ghostblade, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Opportunity as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge and Serpent's Fang. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 48.7% win rate over 1 833 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Phase Rush as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Opportunity as a third item. You want to finish the build with Edge of Night, Serylda's Grudge and Spear of Shojin. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 48.9% win rate across 701 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Jayce Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Opportunity as third item. The last 3 options are Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Spear of Shojin. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 47.9% win rate over 359 matches played. Situational Jayce Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jayce build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jayce runes page.
